item.title: Trump: New AI Website Could Change Government Interactions
item.description: Trump introduced America.gov on Tuesday, saying the AI portal could transform how Americans interact with the government.

item.title: IRS Drafts Citizenship Question for 2027 Tax Returns
item.description: The White House is considering adding a citizenship and work authorization question to next year's federal tax return, along with a separate rule proposal.

item.title: ICE confusion ignites MAGA backlash: 'I would have called for impeachment'
item.description: Verbal guidance telling some ICE offices to stop arresting illegal immigrants without criminal histories was rescinded within hours amid fierce backlash.
